_notes: Star systems as UQM 0.8.0 generates them, recorded by running its own LoadSolarSys, GenerateMoons, FillOrbits, DoPlanetaryAnalysis and every generator in planets/generate/ (see tools/extract/golden/systems.c). Game state is all zeros, as in a new game.
rng: RandomContext (libs/math/random2.c). new_context_first is the first number from a new context. Each sequence is [seed given to SeedRandom, seed after it, then 50 numbers].
systems: one per star in starmap order (NUM_SOLAR_SYSTEMS). index is the star's generator (STAR_DESC.Index), sun_seed the sun's rand_seed, sun_type its data_index (star size).
planets: PlanetDesc in order, as LoadSolarSys leaves them. moons: for each planet, MoonDesc as GenerateMoons leaves them on entering that planet's inner system.

Each world: [data_index, radius, location.x, location.y, rand_seed, NumPlanets] and, for worlds with planet data, then [orbit-colour temperature (no greenhouse bonus), temp_color index, AxialTilt, Tectonics, Weather, PlanetDensity, PlanetRadius, SurfaceGravity, SurfaceTemperature, RotationPeriod, AtmoDensity, LifeChance, PlanetToSunDist, RNG seed after the analysis]. The planet data is DoPlanetaryAnalysis into the solar system's own SYSTEM_INFO, as generateOrbital does on entering orbit. The starbase (255) and the Sa-Matra (254) have no planet data.
